verse: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
verse_spoken: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you today as the God who heals.
You see every pain in my body and every hurt hidden in my heart.
Touch the places that ache, and bring strength where I feel weak.
Heal my mind from worry, and fill it with your perfect peace.
Mend what is broken in my emotions, my memories, and my relationships.
Give wisdom to doctors and carers, and bless every treatment with your hand.
When healing takes time, help me trust you and keep praising you.
I lift up my family and friends who are sick, and ask you to restore them.
Heal everyone praying with me today, for you alone are my praise.
